texts.facts: 3. While hearing the instant writ petitions, a question arose as to whether the respondent Nos.5 and 6 can be said to be technically eligible in terms with Clause 3.(v) of the bid document. 4 4. This aspect arose in view of the fact that from a perusal of the Broad Sheet/Technical Evaluation Report, it appears that insofar as the respondent Nos.5 and 6 are concerned, the turnover of only 4(four) years was taken into account i.e. from 2017-18 to 2020-21. 5. Ms. Tina Mitra, the Member of the Technical Evaluation Committee, who was present during the course of the hearing, upon a query made to her by this Court, it was submitted that the respondent Nos.5 and 6 did not submit the financial report for the year 2021-22, however, they duly submitted the financial report for the last 5(five) years from 2016-17 to 2020-21. She further submitted that the Technical Evaluation Committee taking into consideration that 2016-17 would not be taken into account, disregarded the turnover for that period. However, it is seen that even taking 4(four) years i.e. from 2017 to 2020-21, the Page No.# 6/6 average of the respondent Nos.5 and 6 is more than 1(one) crore of the last 5(five) years.
